interpretation.diagram_classification: uninterpreted (unlabelled concentric circular diagram, possibly cosmological or schematic)
interpretation.interpretation: uninterpreted. The diagram is a set of concentric circles: two outer red circles, a wide ring divided into compartments by pairs of radial lines, a ring of dots, and an empty central circle. It has no transcribed text, so no element can be identified securely. The concentric layout might correspond to a schematic of nested spheres, zones or a calendrical or zodiacal-type wheel. The roughly ten to twelve compartments in the ring might support a division into months, hours or signs. Without labels, none of these readings can be confirmed.
interpretation.evidence: Step 1 recorded no text, so the interpretation can rest only on the shapes: concentric circles, a segmented ring and a dotted ring around an empty centre. Several Step 1 entries are also doubtful. The compartment count was given only as 'about ten' and was not checked. Only the top and bottom compartments were recorded as separate elements, so the other compartments are missing. The vertical double line at the left (entry 7) is probably a page ruling and not part of the diagram. Entry 2 also treated the ring as lying inside the second circle without naming the third red circle that bounds it on the inside. The lack of labels makes a firm classification impossible, so the certainty is low.
